mapping.unused_bl: BL input held at SL virtual ground; programming inhibited. Full physical page loading retained.

integration.physical_basis: 16pF native SL load anchors a deliberately non-aggressive added capacitor choice; added feedback capacitance is separate from native SL capacitance
integration.device_bias: Selected VG=1V, unselected Vpass=4.5V, VBL=0.2V relative to virtually grounded SL; integrator output swing does not move SL
integration.ADC_interface: Local sample/reference adaptation provides guard around the 0.4V useful swing; calibration rejects clipping
integration.frontend_drive_qualification: For each organization, the same capacitor and output swing require output charge/discharge current equal to the full-scale summed current and slew at least V_swing/T_int. c=108 requires 27.648 uA/channel, 1.728 V/us and 3.538944 mA total signal current across 128 channels; these are drive requirements, not measured power.

design_choices.sl_recovery_budget_rule: One additional slot equal to setup budget after each sample; new engineering allocation, not reported recovery time
design_choices.program_budget_bridge: MLC typical -> MLC maximum -> TLC maximum provide complete operation scale. Use as reserved SLC reference windows, with upper window allowing implementation/refinement margin; do not assert SLC bounds or divide by page-size/cell-count.
design_choices.erase_budget_bridge: Both source MLC/TLC columns share15/45ms, anchoring common block-HV/erase/verify/recovery scale;30ms is midpoint. Different charge storage technology remains an explicit transfer assumption.

calibration.procedure: Read zero and full references, compute affine correction, read full reference with half the128 logical inputs enabled, correct and check residual/clipping; no unbounded calibration loop.
calibration.residual_limit_reason: Explicit reference acceptance threshold: four counts gives margin over c=1 half-pattern stochastic variation plus converter error; not an all-vector INT8 error guarantee.

design_choices.read_operation_order: Low-voltage input and BL/SL setup -> fixed integration -> ADC sample/conversion and code latch -> restore/reset -> digital correction and reconstruction. Media time is aggregated across the nonoverlapped stages; reset occurs only after ADC sampling.

resident.append_initial_state: Eight dataWLs erased and two referenceWLs already programmed per block; all coefficients remeasured after loading, so calibration is always charged.
resident.rewrite: Same-address full-matrix replacement:128 serial erases,1024 data-page programs plus256 reference-page programs,then finite calibration.
resident.failure_policy: If a page misses binary threshold verification within P, an erase misses its verify within E, or calibration clips/fails the4-count reference test, do not publish the matrix or count its payload as completed. Return failure; no hidden automatic retry. Numerical ranges describe successful reference operations satisfying these chosen windows, not yield or all-device guarantees.
resident.P_includes: pump/driver setup, every internal program/verify iteration and recovery to ready; data loading is separately counted once
resident.C_is: whole-matrix finite calibration sequence after every append/rewrite; no free C=0 branch

shared_exceptions.change: 128 native blocks implement 8 weight planes × 16 parallel outputs; 8 WL output groups; no independent input replication
shared_exceptions.effect: 64 evaluations / 64 ADC batches, 8 WL setups; same 128 Byte stream and 16384 Byte matrix

shared_exceptions.change: Main c=1, only 128 active BL/page; c=108 is the sole comparison; both retain full 1728 Byte page loading and native dimensions
shared_exceptions.effect: Integration time changes with summed current; same page/block counts and write budgets. Error capability differs at fixed logical format.

shared_exceptions.change: 128 virtual-ground integrating frontends, each with 16 pF feedback capacitance and 0.4 V useful swing; explicit setup/integration/conversion/recovery sequence
shared_exceptions.effect: 2048 pF added integration capacitance; 530–750 ns setup and matching recovery are budgets; integration time is charge-derived, not a borrowed normal-read cycle

shared_exceptions.change: One additional digital correction tick per reconstruction round, 128 small multipliers; 2 calibration WLs/block and finite 3-read calibration
shared_exceptions.effect: kA=3, 192 digital ticks; full rewrite requires 1280 program cycles + 128 erases; calibration does not increase payload

shared_exceptions.change: Cross-source full program/erase scale used as reserved reference windows with binary-verification deadlines
shared_exceptions.effect: Finite P/E/C and tau/ridge; source MLC/TLC endpoints and mode guarantees are not transferred; one update domain and 8 useful data pages/erase are preserved

method_notes: Shared sequential composition already expresses different WL/SL/digital counts; common formulas and API are unchanged.
This case completes numerical estimates using explicitly chosen resource and service budgets; arithmetic checks alone do not validate analog settling or program yield.
P/E budgets are not SLC measurement bounds; calibration and failure policy define the reference-operation class.
